t: This is the Old School Building at Highgate School, in Haringey. It was designed by Frederick Pepys Cockerell, who lived from 1833 to 1878. Cockerell was a British architect and the second son of Charles Robert Cockerell, also an architect. His father admired French architecture and the use of sculpture in buildings, and that was a major influence on him. The school's chapel nearby was designed by the same architect, so the two buildings share a designer.
